headline: Chowan overtake Young Harris as the conference's top scorers
dek: Chowan have scored nineteen goals, more than any other programme, and eleven different players have shared them. The goals have not bought a clean record: Chowan have lost two matches and drawn two, and Young Harris, still unbeaten, remain above them in the table.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Chowan's nineteen goals have come from eleven different scorers and still sit beside two defeats and two draws; goals have not been the shortage.

wire.line: King have lost every match they have played; Lees-McRae have yet to lose one.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fourteen matches dated before today carry no result at all, the earliest Converse's home match against Spartanburg Methodist and the latest Virginia State's home match against Mount Olive.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: King have lost all six of their matches, scoring three goals and conceding seventeen; only two players have scored for them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Enzo Joly, a freshman, has seven of Emmanuel's sixteen goals, from 24 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lees-McRae have won five matches and drawn two and are yet to lose; they have conceded four goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Francis Marion have won six matches, drawn one and lost one, scoring eighteen goals and conceding six.

last_match.line: Ferrum had not lost all season before this; Southern Wesleyan have won back-to-back conference matches.

next_match.line: Lees-McRae have yet to concede a goal at home; King have not scored since Converse visited them.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
